name: 98270 · Marysville, WA
findings: ZIP 98270 (Marysville) has 99 nonprofit organizations. 53 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98270 (Marysville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 98270 (Marysville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 57 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
